verdict.rationale: Wave is double-entry accounting software that lets users create bills, so an AP aging and vendor-balance report is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents only P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reports with period comparisons. It never mentions an accounts payable aging report, vendor balance views, or as-of-date reporting. Bill creation and general reports are adjacent features and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
